test_name: ceiling test + per-trade explanations (SHAP)

Conclusion: stop feature engineering on this table; remaining gains are in data we don't have (desk presence, his read of context).

test_name: matched twins: what still differs when everything known is equal

test_name: PROFIT TEST spec v1 (discovery months, frozen before run)
window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v1: v6>=6 entries, last-5-min-move direction, next-bar-open fill, 2.5pt stop, far-edge target (fixed-2pt comparison arm), 3-bar time stop, 5-min cooldown, RTH, one position, force-flat at close

Fixed-2pt arm loses less (-63.3). DECISIVE DIAGNOSIS from the imitation frame: on the SAME entry minutes, HE won 82% (Oct) / 71% (Feb) while the system won 49%/38% and lost points - the ENTRY selection is fine (validated, T-EN24), the ASSEMBLED EXITS are the failure. Arm B is the first non-losing configuration: win rate only 31% but avg win +5.00 vs avg loss -2.24 - the fast-fail mechanic (dump early losers at 2 pts in the first 2 minutes, let survivors breathe to 4) flips the asymmetry the way HIS behavior does. notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: worse than v2 (-135 vs +6.2, arm B). 2x2 ATTRIBUTION (arm B pooled): cooldown5+tgt5.75 +6.2 | cooldown5+WRBexit -40.2 | cooldown0+tgt5.75 -41.0 | cooldown0+WRBexit -135.0 -> BOTH mods cost ~46 pts each and compound. (1) No-cooldown adds 122-174 re-entries that chase the same burst at worse prices into stops. (2) WRB-exit truncates: with-direction WRB exits average +4.4 to +5.6 pts and LOOK excellent, but that is selection - the same trades under the 5.75 target did better, and against-WRB exits dump trades that often recovered. LESSON: his 'new WRB' moments mark where profit IS, but as an exit trigger it cashes too early and as a re-entry window it overtrades. v2B remains the best configuration.

test_name: PROFIT TEST spec v4 (v2B + with-WRB trail)
window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v4: v2B base (cooldown restored, stop 4.0 / fast-fail 2.0 first 2 bars, target 5.75, time 9 bars) + NEW: a same-direction WRB completing mid-trade ratchets the stop to its body far side from the next bar, never loosening; opposite WRBs ignored

hypothesis: v3 lesson: with-direction WRBs mark profit happening - keep the run, remove the risk
confound_risk: exit-stack iteration is now in its 4th variant on the same two months - in-sample fitting risk acknowledged; final config must re-validate on reserved months
notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: arm B +4.5 vs v2B's +6.2 - NEUTRAL standalone (trail fired only 14/320 times; target or time usually resolves first). IMITATION frame improved: +34.7 total on shared moments (Oct +24.5 / Feb +10.2) vs v2B's +24.0 - the trail helps most exactly where his trades were. PLATEAU READ: three exit variants moved totals -103 -> ~breakeven and stopped; the remaining gap to his 71-82% win rate is ENTRY/DIRECTION quality (system 31%), not exit engineering. Next lever is selection (stricter score, flow-confirmed direction, his-KME-list days), and the final configuration must be re-validated out-of-sample before any profitability claim.

test_name: PROFIT TEST spec v5 (event-based exits only; user mods from v4)
window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v5: loss cut = opposite-WRB close OR 5-min-move sign flip (the entry's own speed measure turning against); target = 1st with-WRB trails, 2nd with-WRB exits; time 20 bars; NO fixed price stop, NO fixed target (both removed with the user's field replacements - flagged in the spec before running)
metrics: P&L, exit mix; standalone + imitation
method: bar-level sim; selftests for all three new exit paths
hypothesis: user-directed variant: fully event-based exit logic
confound_risk: no price stop -> loss size bounded only by when the lagging events fire
notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: -254.2 pts pooled (win 35%, avg win +4.60 avg loss -3.77); imitation frame also negative (-35.0). MECHANISM OF FAILURE, clean: 81% of exits are the two cut events, and both are LAGGING - an opposite WRB's close is by definition already ~3+ pts of adverse body, and the 5-min sign flip waits for the whole trailing move to turn - so losers are cut at -3.77 avg vs v2B's -2.18 price-stop cuts, while winners stay ~+4.6. Event-based cuts recognize the same losers a price stop does, just LATER and at worse prices. Standing ranking after 5 specs: v2B +6.2 > v4B +4.5 > v2A -37 > v1 -103 > v3B -135 > v5 -254. Exit lesson now triple-confirmed: fast PRICE-based loser cut + room for winners is the profitable geometry; further exit variants have hit the plateau - the open frontier is SELECTION/DIRECTION (system 31-35% wins vs his 71-82%), and any final config re-validates out-of-sample before profitability claims.

test_name: PROFIT TEST spec v6 (opp-WRB cut + 5-bar progress + 2.5 hard stop + trail/2nd-WRB)
window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v6: loss cut = opposite WRB at close OR no favorable progress at bar 5 (floor 0.0 = his winners' p25 at 5 min, anchored before run) OR hard 2.5-pt intrabar stop; target = trail on 1st with-WRB, exit on 2nd; time 20 bars
metrics: P&L, exit mix; standalone + imitation

hypothesis: user-directed variant with the v5 lesson applied (price floor restored)

notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: -104.8 pooled; Oct nearly breakeven (-6.5), Feb -98.2. Win rate 24%; the hard stop took 65% of all exits (202/312) - in high-volatility Feb-2022 a fixed 2.5 pts is inside normal noise and fires constantly, before any with-WRB can arm the trail. The no-progress cut almost never fired (5/312; other exits resolve first). CONFIRMS across 6 specs: (1) stop width must clear his winners' heat (4.0 worked, 2.5 fails twice now); (2) Feb punishes every fixed-tick parameter - exits need the same volatility-scaling the ENTRY conditions needed (prior-session references), which is the recommended v7 change; (3) fast-fail (2.0 only in the first 2 bars) remains in every best-of-family config. Ranking: v2B +6.2 > v4B +4.5 > v6 -105 ~ v1 -103 > v3B -135 > v5 -254.

window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v7: U = prior session's median WRB body; stop 1.6U, fast-fail 0.8U first 2 bars, target 2.3U, WRB trail, time 9 bars; direction requires 5-min move AND pressure to agree (else skip); 15-min pressure > 4.6 skips

RESOLUTION LIMIT REACHED on discovery data: config ranking moves to the reserved months (v2B/v4B geometry can profit-validate there now with the no-flow entry subscore; v7's direction gate needs pressure data -> the two purchased tick months). His same-month stats now in every readout: Oct 82% win, +8.6/-1.3 avg (as parsed); Feb 71%, +5.8/-1.8 - his asymmetry (win MORE often AND bigger) remains unmatched by any config.

test_name: the selection gap: within-flagged study + direction autopsy
window1: A: within-flagged taken-vs-left AUC battery (16 features); B: simulated winners-vs-losers battery; C: direction truth = sign of the 9-bar forward move after each flagged signal; accuracy of candidate direction rules + slices; follow-up: accuracy split by whether HE took the signal

notes: RESULT 2026-11-15, the project's sharpest statement of his edge: (A) within the flagged set NO feature separates his picks from his passes (best: tape-speed ratios ~0.57-0.58, CIs straddle 0.5) - his residual selection is INVISIBLE to our 16 features, consistent with the ceiling test. (B) nothing predicts our simulated trade winning either (n=41/94, all null). (C) DIRECTION TRUTH: measured against the actual 9-bar forward move, the 5-min-move rule is right only 54.9% across all flagged signals (both-agree 55.3%, slices 52-58%) - the earlier 70% was agreement with HIS side at HIS moments. THE SPLIT: at flagged signals HE TOOK, the 5-min move predicted the forward move 66.7%; at flagged signals he left, 51.5% - A COIN FLIP. He is not selecting on different features; he is selecting MOMENTS WHEN DIRECTION IS KNOWABLE, and that knowability is the unmeasured component the ceiling test located. CONSEQUENCE: the system's ~30% win rate comes from trading the coin-flip majority of flags. ROADMAP: closing this needs NEW data families aimed at direction-predictability - order-book depth imbalance (10-level book, in hand, unused), cross-market volatility agreement (his stated stand-aside factor; needs NQ/YM bars), finer flow microstructure. Feature-set iterations on the current table are exhausted.

test_name: how he determines direction: reversal behavior + direction-rule hunt

notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: THE USER'S FRAMING WINS. (1) REVERSALS ARE THE MECHANISM: 15.1% of all episodes are reversals; 37% of ALL his losers are flipped within 5 min, and the flipped leg wins 80% (avg +3.7 vs -1.6 paid on the first leg; pair net positive 57%). His 71-82% win rate is substantially MANUFACTURED BY CORRECTION, not prediction. (2) The direction-rule hunt came up empty: level break/reject 48.7%, book imbalance 47.5-52.6%, move+book agree 55.3% at 20% coverage - nothing beats the 5-min move's 54.9%, and every rule scores ~67% on his picks vs ~coin-flip on his passes (the recurring moment-selection signature, which remains unmeasured). CONSEQUENCE for the strategy: stop trying to predict better; CORRECT better - spec v8 candidate = reverse once on fast-fail stop (flip the position with a fresh exit stack, no re-reverse), mechanizing his observed behavior. The earlier 'knowability' framing (T-EN32) is superseded by this row.

window1: STRATEGY_SPEC_v8: fast-fail stop (first 2 bars) flips the position at the stop price, same exit stack from the next bar, one flip max; arm A on the v2B base, arm B on the v7 base; entries bit-identical to the bases (captured from their own code)

hypothesis: T-EN33: 37% of his losers flipped, flips win 80% - mechanize the correction, not the prediction
expected_signal_shape: v8 > its base in both months

notes: RESULT 2026-11-15: THE REVERSAL MECHANIC WORKS.
